descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
About the Opportunity 
 A growing defense technology company in Bucharest is expanding its embedded systems team and is looking for a Junior C++ Embedded Systems Engineer .
 This is an opportunity for recent graduates and junior engineers with 2-4 years of experience to work on real-world embedded and real-time systems in a multidisciplinary environment combining software and hardware.
 You will join an experienced engineering team, take part in meaningful technical projects, and work directly with international clients.
 What You'll Do 
Develop real-time and embedded software applications in C++
Work with CMake as the primary build system
Develop and troubleshoot software in multidisciplinary hardware and software environments
Contribute to system integration and engineering activities
Work with Linux-based development environments
Gain exposure to web technologies and REST APIs
Travel internationally to client sites as part of project activities
 Requirements 
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field
Strong understanding of C++ and Object-Oriented Programming principles
Fluent Romanian and English
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary engineering teams
2-4 years of professional experience - recent graduates are welcome
 Nice to Have 
Experience working in Linux environments
Familiarity with CMake
Exposure to web development or REST APIs
Experience with embedded or real-time systems
 Why Join 
 This is an opportunity to build hands-on experience early in your career, work on multidisciplinary technology projects, and take real ownership as part of a growing engineering team.
 The position is based in Bucharest, Romania and includes international travel to client sites.
